reviews.text:
A truly excellent experience! I left Queenie with Jacopo for quite a long time and felt very comfortable from the start. Jacopo is reliable, attentive, and you can tell he truly loves dogs.

He kept me updated throughout, sending me photos and telling me how Queenie was doing. He took her on beautiful walks, both at the beach and in the mountains, and the photos showed how calm and happy she was.

When she came home, she was calm, happy, and in perfect health. For me, that's the most important thing.

I absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for a serious and trustworthy person to entrust their dog to. Thank you, Jacopo, for taking such great care of Queenie! ❤️🐾

Thanks to Jacopo's intervention, my dog, whom I adopted from a shelter and who had been traumatized by violent incidents with dogs and humans in the past, was able to regain his confidence and be less aggressive towards others.
Kind, professional, and friendly, Jacopo was a great help in improving my Lucky's critical issues.

Hi,

We're a family with a male Border Collie puppy, Bars, who turns 8 months old today!

When he was 5 months old, he was very lively, and I didn't know how to handle certain situations with him. That's when I found Iacopo online and contacted him.

We went on private off-leash walks at the park, during which Iacopo showed me how to communicate with the dog through body movements, not just commands. I would never have been able to let him off the leash without knowing how to handle him properly.

This was crucial in working with Iacopo, not to mention his ability to communicate effectively with the dog: without yelling, without a thousand "no's," but with complete calm in his movements and interactions with the animal. Thank you, Iacopo🐾

I contacted Iacopo after reading the excellent reviews of his work.
We began this journey together to help my dog ​​manage her possessiveness and some aggressive behaviors. Thanks to his expertise and patience, we're making excellent progress, both indoors and outdoors, especially with walking, off-leash walking, and socialization.
The results are truly visible, and most importantly, I've learned to better understand my furry friend and handle situations appropriately.
I absolutely recommend Iacopo to anyone looking for someone knowledgeable, helpful, and passionate about their work.

We began a journey with Iacopo two years ago with our large Corsican dog, who had difficulty socializing and was very wary of people. From the very beginning, he helped us better understand her language, her needs, and the proper way to interact with her.

This year, we also adopted a wonderful mixed-breed, and living with the female Corsican wasn't easy at first. Thanks to Iacopo's support, however, we are making small but significant progress every day with both our puppies.

Iacopo is a down-to-earth person, always available, and above all, very knowledgeable in what he does. The change in our dogs, but also in us and in our daily management, is evident.

We are truly very satisfied and deeply grateful for his help and the journey we are on together.

Iacopo helped me lay a great foundation for my puppy's training. He gave me tons of specific tips to help him feel comfortable in my absence, as well as helping me understand his personality and Lucio's needs. I highly recommend him!

Iacopo is helping us manage the two large dogs we adopted at the same time. They are a mother and daughter, the former too young and deprived, and the latter consequently with little time to regulate her aggressive behavior.
Iacopo is providing us with excellent information, which, with the necessary time, is materially helping us tremendously.
Obviously, he favors a respectful approach that aims to foster a healthy relationship between handler and pet, which, while not the quickest and easiest, as in many other circumstances, is proving to be the best choice.
I greatly admire Iacopo's calm, assertive demeanor, which indirectly encourages me to re-modulate my own reactions, and it's so interesting to observe how the outcomes change!
I turned to Iacopo because it was my first time having a dog in the city and I wanted to take care of it as best as possible. He was truly knowledgeable and helpful. I recommend him 😊 …

We turned to Iacopo to help us best welcome our puppy, Jack. Over the course of five sessions, Iacopo gave us lots of helpful advice on how to help Jack adjust to his new life in the city, both inside and outside the home. Iacopo is a competent, empathetic, and helpful professional. I highly recommend him!

Iacopo is an exceptional dog trainer! He bases his effective methods on abundant real-life experience with dogs and a solid academic background.

Iacopo helped me establish a more collaborative, harmonious and stress-free relationship with my energetic puppy dog.

We turned to Iacopo for Charlie, our 2-year-old poodle, to help us understand and manage him as best as possible. Charlie had severe separation anxiety, which made it difficult to leave him home alone. We worked both inside and outside the home, trying to build a more balanced relationship and meet his needs as much as possible. There's still a lot of work to do, but we recommend Iacopo for his expertise and kindness.

We entrusted our dachshund Mirtilla (who is kind and patient) to Iacopo when she was 8 months old, and thankfully we did! Every day, thanks to his advice, we see small improvements in her, and she's not an easy dog, given her strong personality. Our main problem was her constant need for attention during meals and when we had guests. Iacopo taught us to understand her behavior and act accordingly. Even our walks in the park have improved, and we feel more at peace.

I can’t say enough good things about Iacopo- he really understands a dog’s psychology and  what motivates them- this in turn allows him to anticipate their actions and correct them in advance. We moved to Milan and had a really difficult time with our dog’s manners on a leash- Iacopo did what other trainers could not, and has improved my dog’s walks 1000%. I’m really grateful to him, and can recommend him to anyone

We turned to Iacopo for support with some of our dachshund's behaviors, and we couldn't be more satisfied. From the very beginning, he proved to be professional, knowledgeable, and very attentive in understanding our dog's personality and family dynamics.

He provided us with practical, personalized advice that was easy to implement in everyday life. We particularly appreciated his ability to explain, such as how to approach water sources for our dachshund.

Thanks to his help, we are noticing improvements and, above all, we feel more confident in managing certain situations that previously posed us difficulties, such as letting our dog loose.
We highly recommend him to anyone seeking serious, respectful, and competent help to establish a more balanced and peaceful relationship with their dog.

Iacopo, besides being extremely helpful and kind, knows how to read dogs very well! We worked with my mixed-breed puppy in just four sessions, and he accurately identified several of her characteristics, correcting mistakes I didn't know I was making, and following her in multiple contexts (on the street, at home, at the park, free-roaming, or on a leash). It's an experience I recommend to everyone, because even dogs speak to those who understand them!

We're extremely satisfied with the journey we've made with trainer Jacopo! Our 6-month-old poodle, thanks to his professional support, has become a balanced, calm, and well-behaved puppy.
In a short time, the dog has learned to stay calm even when alone at home, something we initially thought impossible. Furthermore, he now plays with other dogs confidently and joyfully, without anxiety or excesses. We've seen tangible improvement week after week, always with a gentle, respectful, and personalized approach to our needs.

Iacopo has helped us to understand our dog and her character much better, so we can manage our relationship for our and her benefit as well. He really knows what he is doing I we really reccomend him if you want to adjust your relationship with your dog :)
Very knowledgeable instructor, he helped us a lot with Nino

We took a package of five lessons with Iacopo and had a really great time, both us and Dina! Our main goal was to teach Dina to walk off-leash, but overall we wanted to learn how to interact with her in the best possible way, interpreting her signals and understanding her needs, and thanks to Iacopo we succeeded even with such a few lessons. Iacopo was professional, punctual, and truly excellent at teaching, without ever judging the way your four-legged friend lives. Highly recommended, and we'll definitely be back for some refresher lessons :)

Iacopo has been a valuable asset to our dog Nacho and to us. From the very beginning, he proved to be competent, attentive, and capable of adapting the training to Nacho's personality (and as a half-Beagle, I can assure you, that's not easy at all). The improvements were evident: more attentiveness, more confidence, and better management in everyday situations. In addition to his professionalism, I appreciated his willingness to give us practical advice. Highly recommended!
